long_biography.plain_text:
Before leading CSI International, David Hammond spent six years in the United States Navy submarine service and worked with Dennis Conner’s winning Stars & Stripes team in the 1987 America’s Cup. He later moved through CSI roles in information technology, sales, executive management and operations before becoming chief executive.

At CSI, Hammond made staff retention an operating priority. He protected management and supervisory jobs during the pandemic, invested in training and promoted cleaners into management, while the business served commercial, educational and institutional facilities across several states. He also favoured direct authority for local managers, giving them room to adjust staffing and procedures with clients. That people-centred approach became the clearest signature of his tenure.
long_biography.html:
Before leading CSI International, David Hammond spent six years in the United States Navy submarine service and worked with Dennis Conner’s winning Stars & Stripes team in the 1987 America’s Cup. He later moved through CSI roles in information technology, sales, executive management and operations before becoming chief executive.

At CSI, Hammond made staff retention an operating priority. He protected management and supervisory jobs during the pandemic, invested in training and promoted cleaners into management, while the business served commercial, educational and institutional facilities across several states. He also favoured direct authority for local managers, giving them room to adjust staffing and procedures with clients. That people-centred approach became the clearest signature of his tenure.
